name: cursor
doc: Cursor CLI (cursor-agent) on a Cursor subscription: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Composer models through one login. One login per machine (`cursor-agent login`); a second account can only go through an API key (CURSOR_API_KEY in the roster entry's env), which is the user's call. `auto` is not a model: pin a model id from `cursor-agent --list-models`.

usage.note: no CLI usage probe: the plan's usage is on cursor.com (Settings > Usage); the reset time in a quota error is parsed by run-model

tokens.note: the Cursor CLI keeps no token counts in its chat store (~/.cursor/chats); see cursor.com > Usage
